velocity-areas.alt: The velocity v(t) = t² − 4t + 3 m/s for 0 ≤ t ≤ 4 s. It is positive on (0, 1) and (3, 4), where the region between the graph and the t-axis is shaded crimson with area 4/3 each, and negative on (1, 3), where the region below the axis is shaded blue with area 4/3. Displacement adds signed areas: 4/3 m. Total distance adds the areas: 4 m.
